dsh-fork-graph is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Git-style conversation fork graph in the session header: colored lanes and fork curves show which session branched from which, with click-to-jump navigation.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-73ea936619d2b17679d0.html
